name: Vikings
description: The Vikings are raiders from the north that overwhelmed their enemies with powerful melee infantry that could live off enemy lands. Their flexible Longhouses allow them to build up their population and economy with ease. Sagas and the Norse religion inspire their warriors to fight without fear for the honor of the gods.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Sagas can grant bonuses by accomplishing various quests.
Villagers are automatically recruited from Town Centers up to the Villager Capacity which can be increased by building Longhouses.
Longhouses can be upgraded with various attachments and recruit Bondi.
The Völur unit can increase the production speed of Longhouses or set up Sacred Groves on Relics.
Military infantry can heal by consuming Food from Food deposits.
The Vikings lack Stone walls, but palisades can be upgraded to Danevirke walls that take less fire damage.

overview.title: Sagas
overview.description: Sagas are quests that can be completed at any time which will unlock permanent bonuses.

overview.title: Northern Migration
overview.description: Town Centers automatically recruit Villagers at no cost up to the Villager Capacity. The Villager Capacity is increased by +10 for each Longhouse constructed.

overview.title: Longhouse
overview.description: Longhouses can be upgraded with one of four different attachments. The Farmstead adds two vegetable fields, which have a higher gather rate than normal Farms. The Bee Skeps will passively generate gold. Looms will automatically improve the armor of military units. The Smithy will automatically improve the damage of military units.

overview.title: Völur
overview.description: Völur are support units that can travel between Longhouses, boosting the production of Bee Skeps and Farmsteads for a duration. The Völur can also be sacrificed to establish a Sacred Grove on Relics, which passively recruits Berserkers and has an aura that increases the armor of nearby units.

overview.title: Bondi
overview.description: Bondi are unique spearmen that have increased health and armor. When Bondi are near each other, they gain a Shield Wall buff temporarily increasing their health.

overview.title: Berserker
overview.description: The Berserker is a unique light armor unit that has high damage, fast movement speed, and is armed with two axes. Berserkergang is triggered at low health, which regenerates health and increases damage.

overview.title: Living Off The Land
overview.description: Military infantry can heal themselves by gathering Food from deposits such as Berry Bushes, Deer or Boar.

overview.title: Longship and Drakkar
overview.description: The Longship is a unique archer ship that also acts as a transport, each loaded unit increases the arrows fired and increases health. The Drakkar replaces the Springald Ship and can throw nets on enemy ships to slow them down.

overview.title: Influence
overview.description: Construct Longhouses within the Dock's influence to reduce the cost of ships in all Docks by 4% for each Longhouse up to a maximum of 16%.

descriptionCN: 维京人是来自北方的掠袭者，他们以强大的近战步兵征服敌人，并能在敌方土地上生存。灵活的长屋让他们轻松扩展人口和经济。史诗传说与北欧宗教激励战士们无畏战斗，捍卫神明的荣誉。

overviewCN.title: 文明加成
list: 通过完成各种萨迦任务获得奖励。
村民会自动从城镇中心招募，直到达到村民上限，村民上限可通过建造长屋提升。
长屋可升级不同配件，并招募邦地。
维勒尔单位可提升长屋生产速度，或在圣物上建立神圣树林。
军事步兵可通过消耗食物（来自食物储备）进行治疗。
维京人没有石料城墙，但木栅栏可升级为丹麦长城，受到火焰伤害更少。

overviewCN.title: 萨迦
overviewCN.description: 萨迦是一种任务，随时都可完成，并解锁永久奖励。

overviewCN.title: 北方迁移
overviewCN.description: 城镇中心会自动免费招募村民，直到达到村民上限。每建造一个长屋，村民上限增加 +10。

overviewCN.title: 长屋
overviewCN.description: 长屋可升级为四种不同配件之一。农庄可增加两块蔬菜田，其采集效率高于普通农田。蜂箱会被动产出黄金。织布机会自动提升军事单位的护甲。铁匠铺会自动提升军事单位的伤害。

overviewCN.title: 维勒尔
overviewCN.description: 维勒尔是辅助单位，可在长屋间穿梭，在一段时间内提升蜂箱和农庄的产量。维勒尔还可牺牲以在圣物上建立神圣树林，神圣树林会被动招募狂战士，并为附近单位提供护甲光环。

overviewCN.title: 邦地
overviewCN.description: 邦地是独特的长矛兵，拥有更高的生命值和护甲。当邦地彼此靠近时，将获得盾墙增益，暂时提升生命值。

overviewCN.title: 狂战士
overviewCN.description: 狂战士是独特的轻甲单位，拥有高伤害、快速移动速度，并装备双斧。当生命值较低时，会触发狂战士暴怒，自动恢复生命并提升伤害。

overviewCN.title: 靠土地生活
overviewCN.description: 军事步兵可通过采集食物（如浆果丛、鹿或野猪等）自我治疗。

overviewCN.title: 维京长船与德拉卡尔
overviewCN.description: 维京长船是一种独特的弓箭船，同时可作为运输船，每装载一个单位都会增加射箭数量并提升生命值。德拉卡尔取代扭力弩炮船，可向敌舰投网，使其减速。

overviewCN.title: 影响力
overviewCN.description: 在码头影响范围内建造长屋，每建造一座长屋，所有码头的船只成本降低 4%，最多可降低至 16%。
